title: 第13章 恰于人间守仙缘第14章 大道争锋
content_zh:
离开招财犬坊，陈知白直奔灵界道观大门而去。
一路上，像他这般，领着一群猎犬者，不再少数。
但更多之人，仅仅携带两三只御兽。
陈知白满打满算，修行不过三个月，以他眼下修为，最多操控两三头普通野兽。
因此一般人纠结是哪几种野兽。
犬类却不一样，无需太多操控，作为群居动物的它们，一个指令足矣。
这也是犬系和猿系成为热门选择的原因之一。
陈知白早已将兽纹拓印而去，与众犬建立联系，心神一动，指令便至。
因此虽然带着一群狗，却显得游刃有余。
灵界老律观山门极大，乃是一座山头雕镂而成的牌楼。
牌楼下，人流如织，不知多少弟子进进出出，各色御兽，目不暇接。
陈知白行至牌楼，忽见一行七八人，扎堆站在一边，显得人多势众。
当先之人，身着锦蓝道袍，跨坐一头五色麋鹿，鹿角晶莹如珊瑚，正是有过一面之缘的夏韬。
他身旁站着曾子昂几人，正围着他谈笑风生。
再看曾子昂，两月不见，已然褪去杂役气质，多了几分仙家气度。
其肩头立着一条黑腹蛇，蛇首高昂，吐信不休，身下坐着一头铁鬃山猪，獠牙外翻，壮硕如牛。
其余几人亦各携带各种御兽，或猿，或犬，或马，数量不多，平均每人两三头的样子。
夏韬一眼瞧见陈知白，眸中讶色一闪。
当即轻提鹿缰靠了过来，拱手笑道：“原来是陈兄，倒是巧了。看这架势，也是为了山中帝流浆而去？”
陈知白停步还礼：“正是。”

“就一人？”
夏韬望了望他身旁群犬，笑道：“灵界不同人间，山深路险，妖物丛生。陈兄若不嫌弃，不若同行？彼此也好有个照应。”
陈知白摇头道：“夏师兄美意心领了，只是这些猎犬，野性未驯，恐惊扰诸位师兄弟的御兽。”
夏韬闻言也不强求，只再度拱手：
“既如此，便预祝陈兄旗开得胜，满载而归。”
“亦祝夏师兄一行顺遂。”陈知白回礼，告辞离去。
人群中，曾子昂悄然松了口气，目光扫过陈知白座下群犬，心中闪过一丝迟疑。
陈知白不过先他一个月入道，怎么参悟了这么多兽纹？
心中正想着，身旁传来一声低笑：“夏师兄所言不虚，这些独行侠，为壮声势，独修一系，这要是遇到相克妖物，必死无疑。”
有人附和道：“没错！夏师兄好心邀请，还当我们占他便宜似的。”
正说着，倏有低沉虎啸传来，声如闷雷，震得心慌。
众人循声望去，便见一名身穿长老制服的中年修士，端坐虎背，摇摇晃晃而来。
夏韬见状一喜，连忙拱手道：“二叔！”
旁边众人如梦初醒，连忙跟着拱手见礼。
“嗯！”
中年修士嗯了一声，扫了一眼夏韬身后等人，摸了摸虎颈道：“走吧！”
“好！”
曾子昂见状，心中迟疑顿去。
……
……

陈知白出了牌楼，观外景象依旧，人影绰绰，喧哗之声，不绝于耳。
content_en:
After leaving the Lucky Dog House, Chen Zhibai went straight to the gate of the Taoist temple in the spiritual world.
Along the way, there were no longer a few people like him who led a group of hounds.
But more people only carry two or three beasts.
Chen Zhibai had calculated very well and had only practiced for three months. With his current level of cultivation, he could control at most two or three ordinary beasts.
Therefore, most people are confused about which kinds of beasts they are.
Dogs are different. They don't need much control. As social animals, one command is enough.
This is one of the reasons why the dog and ape lines are popular choices.
Chen Zhibai had already stamped the animal patterns and established contact with the dogs. The command came as soon as his mind moved.
Therefore, even though he was carrying a group of dogs, he seemed to be at ease.
The gate of Laoluguan Mountain in the spiritual world is huge, and it is an archway carved from the top of a mountain.
Under the archway, there was a huge flow of people. Countless disciples came in and out, and there were all kinds of beasts to watch.
When Chen Zhibai walked to the archway, he suddenly saw a group of seven or eight people standing together on one side, making it appear that there was a large number of people.
The person in charge was wearing a brocade blue Taoist robe, sitting astride a five-color elk, the antlers of which were as crystal clear as coral. He was Xia Tao, whom he had met once before.
Next to him stood Zeng Ziang and several others, talking and laughing around him.
Looking at Zeng Zi'ang again, I haven't seen him for two months. He has lost his handyman temperament and gained a bit of immortality.
There is a black-bellied snake standing on its shoulder, its head is held high, and it is spitting messages endlessly. Under the body sits an iron-bristle boar with outward-turned tusks, as strong as an ox.
The remaining people also brought various beasts, such as apes, dogs, or horses. The number was not large, with an average of two or three per person.
Xia Tao glanced at Chen Zhibai and his eyes flashed with surprise.
He immediately picked up the reins of the deer and came closer, cupped his hands and said with a smile: "It turns out to be Brother Chen, what a coincidence. Looking at this posture, does he also go to the Emperor of the Mountain?"
Chen Zhibai stopped and returned the courtesy: "Exactly."
"Just one person?"
Xia Tao looked at the group of dogs beside him and said with a smile: "The spiritual world is different from the human world. The mountains are deep and the roads are dangerous and there are many monsters. If Brother Chen doesn't dislike it, why don't we go together? It's better to take care of each other."
Chen Zhibai shook his head and said: "Senior Brother Xia kindly accepts it, but these hounds are wild and untamed and may disturb the beasts of all senior brothers."
When Xia Tao heard this, he didn't force it, he just handed it over again:
"In that case, I wish Brother Chen a great success and return home with a full load."
"I also wish Senior Brother Xia a smooth trip." Chen Zhibai returned the greeting and said goodbye.
Among the crowd, Zeng Ziang breathed a sigh of relief. He glanced at the group of dogs under Chen Zhibai's seat, and a trace of hesitation flashed in his heart.
Chen Zhibai only entered Taoism a month before him, how could he comprehend so many animal patterns?
Just as he was thinking in his mind, a low chuckle came from beside him: "What Senior Brother Xia said is true. These lone rangers, in order to gain momentum and cultivate their own lineage, will definitely die if they encounter a monster that is against them."
Someone echoed: "That's right! Senior Brother Xia invited us kindly, and he thought we were taking advantage of him."
Just as he was talking, a low tiger roar suddenly came, the sound was like muffled thunder, which made him panic.
Everyone followed the sound and saw a middle-aged monk wearing an elder's uniform, sitting upright on the back of a tiger, staggering over.
Xia Tao was overjoyed when he saw this and quickly said, "Second uncle!"
Everyone around him seemed to have woken up from a dream and quickly followed him in greeting.
"Yeah!"
The middle-aged monk hummed, glanced at the others behind Xia Tao, touched the tiger's neck and said, "Let's go!"
"Okay!"
When Zeng Ziang saw this, he hesitated in his heart.
…
…
Chen Zhibai walked out of the archway and saw that the scene outside was still the same, with shadows of people and noisy sounds.
